title: Verify: Held lock and budget stop unit tests
summary: Unit tests for lock-held no-side-effects and budget-stop persistence
description: Add two tests: a held lock leaves no execution record or worktree; a budget stop persists FAILED, wraps ErrBudgetExceeded and removes the worktree once.
acceptance_criteria: Held lock: ErrLocked, zero agent calls, no worktree, store.Get returns an error
Budget stop: ErrBudgetExceeded, 2 calls, stored FAILED, one worktree removal

steps.action: Build newRunner(t, Config{}, &fakeAgent{}); create the lock dir and write the file h.cfg.LockPath as in TestRunLocked; call Run; assert errors.Is(err, lock.ErrLocked), agent.calls == 0, len(h.trees.created) == 0, and h.st.Get("EXEC-1") returns a non-nil error.

Use fakeAgent{cost: 3.0, errs: six errors} and Config{MaxRetries: 5, MaxBudget: 5.0, Timeout: 5 * time.Second}; call Run; assert errors.Is(err, ErrBudgetExceeded), agent.calls == 2, stored Status == store.StatusFailed, stored Error contains "budget exceeded" and len(h.trees.removed) == 1.
